sources.title: Schools Capital Delivery
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's Schools Capital Delivery team manages school asset planning, capital projects, SEN development and decarbonisation; the council states demand for SEN places exceeds current availability, which is a borough capacity signal rather than parcel proof.

sources.title: Education Strategic Partnerships and Resources
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's ESRP service coordinates school resources, buildings and pupil-place planning so capacity can respond to population change; service planning does not establish development at the sample parcel.

sources.title: Major education capital projects
sources.verified_claim: Enfield reports current major school projects including a school rebuild and special-school expansion and links capital investment to accessibility, SEN and decarbonisation; project delivery is school-specific, not parcel-specific growth evidence.

sources.title: Public notices and consultations
sources.verified_claim: Enfield records a 2026 decision to establish an autism/complex-needs Special Resourced Provision with 8 places from September 2026 and a further planned 8-place phase; this is a specific education-capacity action, not sample-parcel development.

sources.title: School Place Planning and Provision
sources.verified_claim: Havering states it has a statutory duty to monitor school-place supply and demand, forecast pupil numbers and plan expansions, including liaison with planning on new housing and developer contributions; forecasts are borough/service evidence, not parcel capacity.

sources.title: New schools and school reorganisations and changes
sources.verified_claim: Havering's 2026 consultation covered a school-based nursery and SEND-unit expansion at R J Mitchell Primary School; consultation and school-change proposals are location-specific education delivery signals, not sample-parcel outcomes.

sources.title: Education and Learning Strategy 2024-2030
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's Education and Learning Strategy includes Pupil Place Planning, SEND, efficient schools and inclusive provision among borough priorities; strategic education need is not treated as a development permission.

sources.title: Social Infrastructure
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's Social Infrastructure guidance covers health, education, community, cultural, play, recreation, faith and emergency facilities and recommends using demographic evidence to assess need; strategic need does not establish sample-parcel provision.
